slides.texte_overlay:
What to do when you've felt
unmotivated for weeks
Stop waiting to feel motivated. Motivation usually comes after you start, not before. Begin with a task so small it feels almost silly.
Check the basics first. Sleep, food, sunlight, movement. Weeks of low energy often start with a body that isn't being looked after.
Change your environment. Work from a café, move your desk, clean your room. A new setting can wake up a tired mind.
Find one thing to look forward to. A trip, a concert, a dinner with friends. Something on the horizon pulls you through flat weeks.
Before: every day felt the same and empty. After: five minutes a day of history, art or science, and small sparks of curiosity came back.
slides.texte_sophia: Before: every day felt the same and empty. After: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. Small sparks of curiosity came back.

slides.texte_overlay: Spend time with energetic people. Motivation is contagious. A training partner or an ambitious friend can lift you more than any video.
Talk to someone if it doesn't lift. Long periods without energy or joy deserve real attention. A doctor or therapist can really help.
